title: Simulated longitudinal workflow demonstration
disclaimer: Simulated longitudinal demonstration. The available SPIDER dataset does not contain true postoperative longitudinal follow-up for this case.
ui_notice: Visual stages use different SPIDER studies to demonstrate the longitudinal workflow. They are not postoperative follow-up scans from the same patient.
interpretation: Four real SPIDER studies from four different patients, arranged into a simulated timeline to demonstrate how a longitudinal system would operate. This is not one patient followed through surgery and recovery, and no postoperative recovery outcome is claimed.

measurement_policy.note: Every measurement and finding shown for a stage is produced by running the frozen Sprint 1 preprocessing, Sprint 3 segmentation and Sprint 5 post-processing pipeline on that stage's real source study. No clinical measurement is fabricated. The simulated element is the arrangement of four unrelated studies into a timeline, not the numbers.
measurement_policy.trend_caveat: Any trend across stages is a consequence of which studies were selected. It is not an observed recovery trajectory and must not be read as one.

selection.rationale: All four studies come from the 33-patient held-out test split, so the segmentation on display was never trained on. Each was verified end to end through the real API - preprocessing, segmentation, Sprint 5 indexing and PNG rendering in original, mask, overlay and findings modes - before being selected.
criteria: T2 modality, because the Pfirrmann estimator is validated on T2 and T2-SPACE only
at least 6 indexed discs with usable lumbar anatomy
passes preprocessing, segmentation and Sprint 5 indexing without error
renders correctly in every viewer mode
visually distinct from the other stages in scanner, resolution and anatomy

stages.label: Pre-Surgery
stages.stage_note: Most degenerate of the four studies: nine thin discs, findings on eight of them. Used as the baseline position in the demonstration timeline.

stages.label: Post-Surgery
stages.stage_note: A different patient with substantial but somewhat less severe degeneration. Occupies the early postoperative position in the demonstration. No surgery is depicted, because no postoperative imaging exists in this dataset.

stages.label: 3-Month Recovery
stages.stage_note: Deliberately a different scanner and field strength from the other stages, so the demonstration also shows the pipeline handling acquisition variation.

stages.label: 6-Month Recovery
stages.stage_note: Least degenerate of the four: six well-preserved discs with a single finding-associated level. Occupies the final position in the demonstration timeline.
